description.value:
You reach into the target's mind and rewire its cognitive architecture, leaving it permanently diminished. The target must attempt a Will save.

The curse persists indefinitely; removing it or the permanent @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied} condition requires a successful counteract check against this spell's rank.

d6Curse EffectEffect
1Haunting PresenceThe target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 2} whenever it can perceive you.
2PhobiaThe target develops a severe phobia and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 2} in the presence of a common object the GM names.
3Shattered IntellectThe target automatically critically fails Intelligence-based skill checks.
4Lingering ConfusionThe target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Confused]{Confused} for 1 minute, then must save against your spell DC each day or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Confused]{Confused} for 1 round.
5AmnesiaThe target cannot Recall Knowledge or use class abilities that require memory of its training.
6RegressionThe target undergoes childlike mental regression, and the GM controls its non-combat social behavior.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 4} permanently and is afflicted with one curse effect from the Cerebral Disruption table, rolled on a d6 or chosen thematically by the GM.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Confused]{Confused} for 1 round.
